source_title: Costain Group PLC Annual Report and Accounts 2019
availability_evidence: Costain released its audited 2019 full-year results on 11 March 2020 and the matching annual report is preserved in the public annual-report archive; direct byte retrieval was rate-limited in the controlled environment.
observation: The adverse A465 arbitration decision produced a £20.0m charge, underlying operating margin fell to 1.3% from 4.1%, the Group reported a £6.6m pre-tax loss and net cash fell to £64.9m. Management also announced a £100m capital raise to strengthen the balance sheet. The A465 charge and capital raise were already disclosed and are excluded. Adjusted operating profit remained £37.9m, margin excluding A465 was 4.1%, and long-term committed infrastructure programmes supported the forward market.
already_announced_exclusion: The A465 contract charge and announced £100m capital raise were public at the cutoff and are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: A major contract loss, sharp reported margin deterioration and weakened cash created substantial intervention pressure, partly offset by profitable underlying operations and a strong long-term market; the disclosed contract response and capital raise are excluded.

source_title: Costain Group PLC Annual Report and Accounts 2021
availability_evidence: Costain released its audited 2021 full-year results on 9 March 2022 and the matching annual report is preserved in the public annual-report archive; direct byte retrieval exceeded the controlled web fetch limit.
observation: The £43.4m Peterborough and Huntingdon contract provision drove a reported £9.5m operating loss and £13.3m pre-tax loss, but the provision and settlement were already disclosed and are excluded. Adjusted revenue increased, adjusted operating profit rose to £30.1m, adjusted operating margin improved to 2.6%, adjusted free cash flow was £53.1m and net cash increased to £119.4m despite £40m borrowings.
already_announced_exclusion: The Peterborough and Huntingdon contract provision and agreed post-year-end settlement were already disclosed and are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: A large already-disclosed contract provision caused a statutory loss, but improving adjusted profit and margin, good free cash flow and higher net cash supplied strong quantified offsets.

source_title: Costain Group PLC Annual Report and Accounts 2023
availability_evidence: Costain's 9 April 2024 issuer notice states that the 2023 Annual Report and Accounts was made available to shareholders and on its website; the official PDF remained page-inspectable, while direct byte retrieval was blocked by DNS resolution in the controlled environment.
observation: Revenue declined 6.3%, and the Group recorded £6.2m of Transformation costs, £1.8m of restructuring costs and costs from repositioning digital services. These programmes and actions were already disclosed and are excluded. Adjusted operating profit rose 10.5% to £40.1m, adjusted operating margin improved 40bps to 3.0%, adjusted free cash flow was £72.0m, net cash rose to £164.4m with no borrowings, and forward work was around three times annual revenue.
already_announced_exclusion: The disclosed Transformation programme, restructuring costs and completed digital-services repositioning are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Explicit transformation and restructuring activity met the lower intervention-pressure anchor but was already announced; improving profit and margin, strong free cash flow, sharply higher net cash and substantial forward work supplied decisive contrary evidence.
